Core ratio 114%. YE2025 153%/116%. Internal targets not disclosed ('well above internal targets'); OSFI supervisory targets 100% total / 70% core. 2025 LICAT guideline change (seg fund guarantee capital) not restated.

FSR A (high); Issuer A (high); Sub debt A; Prefs Pfd-2 (high); LRCN A (low); all Stable; upgraded in 2025. AM Best withdrew its A (Excellent)/'a' ratings in May 2021 at the company's request (https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20210527005699/en/).

Count of named staff on Empire Life Investments Inc. team page: CIO, 14 equities, 6 fixed income/private placements, 2 multi-strategy GIF, 4 portfolio analytics. Manages general fund and seg funds. No official headcount disclosed.
1,201 full-time + 10 part-time in Canada (995 Ontario, 107 Quebec); excludes contract/agency workers. Public Accountability Report 2025.
~6% segregated funds, ~6% group benefits, ~8% new life insurance premiums; among 10 largest Canadian lifecos by total assets (AR 2025 MD&A).

governance: Board + six committees: Audit (stress testing), Conduct Review, HR, Investment (ALM), IT Oversight, Risk and Capital (ERM, appetite, capital)
